big_case.notes: Pro se stay application seeking to halt district-court merits adjudication of an individual Chapter 7 bankruptcy appeal in E.D. Va. while the applicant pursued rehearing of an unpublished Fourth Circuit refusal to grant mandamus disqualifying the district judge. Summarily denied in chambers by The Chief Justice eight days after submission with no response requested, no referral, and zero institutional or doctrinal reach beyond the immediate litigant.

leakage.notes: Forward-mode run on 2026-11-09 (one day before the 2026-11-10 denial), with 100% result capture across 18 calls. A live supremecourt.gov docket check on Nov 9 returned only the Nov 2 submission entry, and corpus/CourtListener lookups returned only pre-disposition records (latest retrieved_doc_date 2026-11-06).
